Location --> Extract the Town/Sector 

Description --> Extract the following: Dimensions, Location details, Storey unit, How many 
    rooms + Type of rooms , Is prime Location, Is corner House, Water bore available,          Which Phase/Block,  Solar Panel available, Elevator
Amenitites: Main Features --> Extract the following BuiltinYear, WindowsType, IsFurnished, HowManyFloors, ElectricityBackupAvail, NoofParkingSpaces, LobbyInBuilding
Amenities: Rooms --> Extract the no.of Bedrooms,Bathrooms,Servant Quarters, Kitchen,Store Rooms, Lounge, Powder Room, Drawing Room, Dining Room, LaundryRoom

Amenities: Main Features --> Extract the following 
    Built in Year, WindowsType, Is Furnished, No of Floors, Electricity Backup, No of Parking Spaces, Lobby in Building

Amenities: Room --> Extract the following Information
    No of: Bedrooms, Bathrooms, Servant Quarters, Kitchen, Store Rooms, Lounge, Powder Room, Drawing Room, Dining Room , Laundry Room

Amenties: Business and Communication --> Extract the Following:
    ATM Machines, Media Room, Conference Room, Intercom
